surface_mechanism_description: GaCl is expected to decompose into Ga only on an As-stabilized surface, but will not decompose on a Ga-stabilized surface. Furthermore, if the surface is completely covered by one monolayer of Ga atoms, no additional Ga or GaCl should adsorb on the surface.
evidence: Considering the self-limiting mechanism of ALE, GaCl is expected to decompose into Ga only on an As-stabilized surface, but will not decompose on a Ga-stabilized surface. Furthermore, if the surface is completely covered by one monolayer of Ga atoms, no additional Ga or GaCl should adsorb on the surface.
